content.title: About
content.content: Popcorn Microwave Plain Light (2987) is a ready‑to‑cook microwave bag containing whole corn kernels without added flavorings or salt. When heated, the kernels pop into light, airy pieces that make a quick snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Popcorn is one of the few corn varieties whose kernels explode when heated due to internal moisture.
Microwave popcorn was introduced in the 1980s and quickly became popular for its convenience.
The light version usually contains less fat and fewer calories than traditional butter popcorn.
Popcorn is a common snack at movie theaters and sporting events because it is fast and easy to prepare.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Light microwave popcorn typically contains 1–3 g of fat per serving, making it less caloric than butter‑flavored versions.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Popcorn is high in dietary fiber, which supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Whole corn kernels provide polyphenols that may help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Popcorn naturally contains no gluten, suitable for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Moderate glycemic index
items.content: Compared with many snack foods, popcorn has a moderate glycemic index, helping to maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Burn risk
items.content: Steam released from the hot bag can cause burns; open the bag carefully, keeping your face away from the steam.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Although marketed as plain, some batches may contain a small amount of salt, which should be considered if you limit sodium.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may be allergic to corn; avoid the product if you have a known corn allergy.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Certain versions may include preservatives or flavor enhancers; check the ingredient list if you are sensitive to food additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Place the bag in the microwave, unfolding it according to the package directions. Cook on high power for 2–3 minutes, stopping when the interval between pops exceeds 2 seconds. Let stand for 30 seconds, then carefully open, stir, and enjoy.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened bag in a cool, dry place away from moisture. After opening, keep the popcorn in an airtight container to prevent moisture absorption, which can cause premature popping.
